story.what_it_does: AIA Engineering makes high chrome mill internals (grinding media and liners) used by mining and cement customers. About 64% of its sales are outside India, and it is pushing into mining with newer products like mill liners and discharge systems.
story.plans: It plans to raise FY27 capex to about ₹350 crore, including a hybrid green energy project and a rubber and composite liners plant. Management also has an internal, non-guidance aim of adding at least 25,000-30,000 tons of volume a year in FY28 and FY29, and talks of reactivating the slowed Ghana and China expansions.
story.moat: The company has a large installed capacity of 436,000 tons a year and net cash of about ₹4,300 crore, with EBITDA margins in the mid-30s percent on a reported basis. Its customers are trialling its newer mining products, but those trials are slow and results are often not shared.

scenarios.story: Mining trials convert into orders, and the 25,000-30,000 ton yearly volume goal is met in FY28 and FY29. Freight costs ease back to 7-8% of sales, and the order book keeps rising.
signals_to_watch: Order book growth beyond ₹1,071 crore reported at 1 October 2026
Management giving formal volume guidance or trial outcomes for the discharge system and South America mines

scenarios.story: Volumes stay roughly flat, around 61,500-64,600 tons a quarter, while trials move slowly. Margins settle lower than last year's levels as FX gains fade, in line with management's 20% operating margin guidance for FY27.
signals_to_watch: Quarterly sales volume against the Q1 FY27 level of 64,644 tons and the Q2 level of 61,508 tons
Operating EBITDA margin versus the 20% FY27 guidance

scenarios.story: Duties in Mexico and the USA, shipping disruption and high freight keep hurting volumes and margins. Receivable days keep rising and trials drag on for years with no wins.
signals_to_watch: Receivable days rising further from 90 in Q1 FY27 and 87 in Q2 FY27
Freight cost staying near 10% of sales and EBITDA margin falling below the 32.50% seen in Q2 FY27
